mukta-m0-p32-v776.quick_english: Having thus established the six limbs, one should perform the placement of the pedestal.

mukta-m0-p32-v777.quick_english: Then one should visualize an ocean of nectar, a jewel island, and a pārijāta tree.

mukta-m0-p32-v778.quick_english: There the hero should place the lotus seat in the lotus of the heart.

mukta-m0-p32-v779.quick_english: One should perform the placement thus; this is the remainder.

mukta-m0-p32-v780.quick_english: Having performed the placement for each of the six limbs, one should then perform the pedestal placement.

mukta-m0-p32-v782.quick_english: One should place dharma, knowledge, sovereignty, and dispassion in order.

mukta-m0-p32-v783.quick_english: And those very principles beginning with dharma, in their na-prefixed forms, are to be taken in proper order.

mukta-m0-p32-v784.quick_english: The pedestal goddesses are to be placed on the filaments, the pericarp, and the petals.

mukta-m0-p32-v785.quick_english: Nandinī, Nārasiṃhī, and Vaiṣṇavī are thus among the eight goddesses.

mukta-m0-p32-v786.quick_english: On the right side: 'anaiśvaryāya namaḥ' and 'avairāgyāya namaḥ'.

mukta-m0-p32-v787.quick_english: With 'namaḥ', one should place the pedestal goddesses on the petals of the heart lotus.

mukta-m0-p32-v789.quick_english: One should place these on the petal tips, and then perform breath control.

mukta-m0-p32-v790.quick_english: Placing the hands at the heart, one should meditate on the eternal goddess.

mukta-m0-p32-v791.quick_english: That formless meditation of yours is beyond the range of speech and mind.

mukta-m0-p32-v792.quick_english: It is inaccessible to yogins, yet accessible through many difficult practices beginning with tranquility.

mukta-m0-p32-v794.quick_english: One should meditate on the eternal goddess, devoid of beginning and end.

mukta-m0-p32-v796.quick_english: Those whose beginning is tranquility are the many practices beginning with tranquility; by them.

mukta-m0-p32-v797.quick_english: I tell you of gross meditation for the awakening of subtle meditation.

mukta-m0-p32-v798.quick_english: The conception of form is made in accordance with qualities and actions.

mukta-m0-p32-v799.quick_english: One should worship with supreme devotion using mental offerings.

mukta-m0-p32-v800.quick_english: The word 'manasa' is explained here as meaning 'quickly' and is to be taken together with the preceding instruction.

mukta-m0-p64-v1576.quick_english: One should be free from arrogance and devoid of mental elation caused by abundant honor.

mukta-m0-p64-v1577.quick_english: The intentions or the activities of the people.

mukta-m0-p64-v1578.quick_english: From arrogance, or from mental eagerness caused by a kingdom and the like.

mukta-m0-p64-v1579.quick_english: Those whose relatives are dead—that is, those in such a bereaved condition.

mukta-m0-p64-v1580.quick_english: One should avoid negligence, vice, laziness, falsehood, and dishonesty.

mukta-m0-p64-v1581.quick_english: From mutual acceptance, the accomplishment of a purchase comes about.

mukta-m0-p64-v1582.quick_english: In the case of those whose minds are confused by disease, gift and sale are not validly accomplished.

mukta-m0-p64-v1583.quick_english: In the opposite case, because those qualities are otherwise, the purchase becomes different.

mukta-m0-p64-v1584.quick_english: Even after a year has passed, that thing to be purchased may be dealt with otherwise.

mukta-m0-p64-v1585.quick_english: Therefore, O lord of the family, that purchase should not be accomplished, by my command.

mukta-m0-p64-v1586.quick_english: The joined one is declared the fourth and the eighth among the elements.

mukta-m0-p64-v1587.quick_english: Whatever is accepted by mortals must be done in accordance with scripture.

mukta-m0-p64-v1588.quick_english: With one's whole being and in every way.

mukta-m0-p64-v1589.quick_english: In the case of unseen things, when there is reversal or contrariety.

mukta-m0-p64-v1590.quick_english: That purchase is the purchase of a human body.

mukta-m0-p64-v1591.quick_english: A man should be attentive and free from laziness in the conduct of service.

mukta-m0-p64-v1592.quick_english: Servants who desire happiness here and hereafter should honor their relatives.

mukta-m0-p64-v1593.quick_english: One should always stand with respectful fear, awaiting the master's command.

mukta-m0-p64-v1594.quick_english: And whatever would cause distress to the master, one should conceal with great effort.

mukta-m0-p64-v1595.quick_english: In his presence, one should abandon improper speech, play, and laughter.

mukta-m0-p64-v1596.quick_english: One should avoid a secluded bed and laughter together with them.

mukta-m0-p64-v1597.quick_english: One should not use footwear, ornaments, or weapons for oneself.

mukta-m0-p64-v1598.quick_english: One should avoid boldness, arrogant speech, and familiar conduct.

mukta-m0-p64-v1599.quick_english: One should avoid lying down in private with the maidservants of the master's house.

mukta-m0-p64-v1600.quick_english: Boldness and audacity are to be avoided.

mukta-m0-p93-v2301.quick_english: One should formulate the statement of permission.

mukta-m0-p93-v2302.quick_english: O beloved, this also includes the maternal grandfathers, the maternal grandmother, and others.

mukta-m0-p93-v2303.quick_english: One should indeed utter the word śrāddha for all the gods, the Viśve Devas.

mukta-m0-p93-v2304.quick_english: The permission statement is declared thus: 'I will perform it, O supreme goddess.'

mukta-m0-p93-v2305.quick_english: Likewise, the permission statement is declared in the case of the maternal grandfather.

mukta-m0-p93-v2306.quick_english: Thus, in the case of the maternal grandfather also, the permission statement must be formulated in just the same way.

mukta-m0-p93-v2307.quick_english: Then, O Śivā, one should recite the Brahman-knowledge, the Gāyatrī, ten times.

mukta-m0-p93-v2308.quick_english: Thus: 'Homage be to Puṣṭi and to Svāhā; may they always indeed be.'

mukta-m0-p93-v2309.quick_english: One should purify the śrāddha materials with the mantra va/ hū/ phaḍiti.

mukta-m0-p93-v2310.quick_english: Having said this, in that vessel endowed with a tulasī leaf...

mukta-m0-p93-v2311.quick_english: Having given a mouthful of water to the brāhmaṇas, one should give a seat of kuśa grass.

mukta-m0-p93-v2312.quick_english: Then, immediately after the formulation of the permission statement. || 31

mukta-m0-p93-v2313.quick_english: One should purify the śrāddha materials.

mukta-m0-p93-v2314.quick_english: O Śivā, the mothers, and also the maternal grandfathers, and likewise the maternal grandmothers.

mukta-m0-p93-v2315.quick_english: The paternal triad, likewise the maternal triad, and the maternal-grandfather triad.

mukta-m0-p93-v2316.quick_english: O Śivā, one should make the inquiry regarding the placing of the vessels according to the divine order.

mukta-m0-p93-v2317.quick_english: One should make two circles each, likewise on both sides as well.

mukta-m0-p93-v2318.quick_english: One should serve water for drinking and foods in proper order.

mukta-m0-p93-v2320.quick_english: One should make it in the circles.

mukta-m0-p93-v2321.quick_english: One should serve in order, beginning with the divine portion and so on.

mukta-m0-p93-v2322.quick_english: Having sprinkled all the foods, to the Viśve Devas and likewise to the ancestors...

mukta-m0-p93-v2323.quick_english: Having dedicated them, one should recite the goddess Gāyatrī thrice to the deities.

mukta-m0-p93-v2324.quick_english: One should make the inquiries regarding the remaining food and the piṇḍas, first and then afterward.

mukta-m0-p93-v2325.quick_english: O beloved, having received the answer from the twice-born, one should arrange twelve balls.

mukta-m0-p64-v1579.question: Who are identified as the bereaved persons in this description?
premises: Their relatives are dead.

mukta-m0-p64-v1580.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p64-v1580.question: Which faults must be abandoned in proper conduct?
premises: Negligence, vice, and laziness are named.

mukta-m0-p64-v1581.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p64-v1581.question: What condition establishes the validity of a purchase?
premises: Mutual acceptance occurs between parties.
A purchase requires accomplishment or validity.
The latter arises from the former.
mukta-m0-p64-v1581.inference: A purchase is accomplished through mutual acceptance.

mukta-m0-p64-v1582.speaker: Abhinavagupta (teacher voice)
mukta-m0-p64-v1582.question: Why are gift and sale invalid when made by those confused by disease?
premises: Some persons have minds confused by disease.
Gift and sale are transactions requiring valid capacity.
In their case there is non-accomplishment.
mukta-m0-p64-v1582.inference: Gift and sale are not validly accomplished when made by those whose minds are confused by disease.

mukta-m0-p93-v2312.plain_english: Then, immediately after the formulation of the permission statement. || 31

mukta-m0-p93-v2313.plain_english: One should purify the śrāddha materials.

mukta-m0-p93-v2314.plain_english: O Śivā, the mothers, and also the maternal grandfathers, and likewise the maternal grandmothers.

mukta-m0-p93-v2315.plain_english: The paternal triad, likewise the maternal triad, and the maternal-grandfather triad.

mukta-m0-p93-v2316.plain_english: O Śivā, one should make the inquiry regarding the placing of the vessels according to the divine order.

mukta-m0-p93-v2317.plain_english: One should make two circles each, likewise on both sides as well.

mukta-m0-p93-v2318.plain_english: One should serve water for drinking and foods in proper order.

mukta-m0-p93-v2320.plain_english: One should make it in the circles.

mukta-m0-p93-v2321.plain_english: One should serve in order, beginning with the divine portion and so on.

mukta-m0-p93-v2322.plain_english: Having sprinkled all the foods, to the Viśve Devas and likewise to the ancestors...

mukta-m0-p93-v2323.plain_english: Having dedicated them, one should recite the goddess Gāyatrī thrice to the deities.

mukta-m0-p93-v2324.plain_english: One should make the inquiries regarding the remaining food and the piṇḍas, first and then afterward.

mukta-m0-p93-v2325.plain_english: O beloved, having received the answer from the twice-born, one should arrange twelve balls.

essence: After establishing the six limbs, the practitioner should perform the pedestal placement in this manner.
The pedestal setting is visualized as a nectar ocean containing a jewel island with a pārijāta tree.
The hero practitioner should place the lotus seat there in the heart lotus.
The placement should be performed thus, with the remainder understood as continuing the procedure.
After performing the placement for each of the six limbs, one should perform the pedestal placement.

essence: Proper conduct requires freedom from arrogance and from pride arising through honor.
Both the intentions and the activities of the people are subject to the stated cause.
People's intentions or activities may arise from arrogance or from ambition for power and the like.
The expression denotes people who are bereaved by the death of their relatives.
One should completely avoid negligence, vice, laziness, falsehood, and dishonesty.

essence: The officiant should formulate the permission statement.
The permission formula includes maternal grandfathers, the maternal grandmother, and others.
One should utter the word śrāddha for the Viśve Devas.
The permission statement is declared as 'I will perform, O supreme goddess.'
The permission statement is likewise declared in the case of the maternal grandfather.
